input.subject: Reminder: dishwasher repair, Flat 12, 78 Copperfield Walk (Ref R/PM011-1)
input.body:
Dear Turner,

Following up on our email of 29 November about Flat 12, 78 Copperfield Walk, Kingshaven, ZZ3 1ZZ (Ref R/PM011-1).

The tenants report that the dishwasher fills and washes but never finishes its cycle. It started recently. We would like to send an appliance contractor to diagnose the fault. We don't have a cost yet. If the repair needs more than the call-out, we will send you the quote before any further work goes ahead.

Please reply APPROVE for us to arrange the diagnostic visit, or DECLINE if you'd prefer to handle it another way (for example through a warranty or your own contractor).

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings

input.subject: Dishwasher update, Flat 12, 78 Copperfield Walk (Ref R/PM011-1)
input.body:
Hello,

An update on your dishwasher report for Flat 12, 78 Copperfield Walk (Ref R/PM011-1). We have asked the landlord to approve a contractor visit and are chasing them for an answer. We'll contact you as soon as we hear back.

Until then, please don't use the dishwasher. If it is running and won't stop, switch it off at the wall. If you see any water leaking, let us know straight away.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings
